svg.text: A leaf scan keeps only the unresolved reads
A task scans the writes of a leaf in key order against its slice of reads, kept as a linked list in begin order. A read leaves the list when it is decided:
conflicting, or ended before the current write. Begins are compared only until they are reached; ends are not sorted, so reads can leave from anywhere in the list.
A read conflicts with a write when the intervals overlap and the write’s CV is greater than the read’s RV. Half-open on both sides: touching at an endpoint is no overlap.
The scan, one write at a time
each row is the list after that write; arrows are nextRead links; a grey cell has left the list; the bracket is the reached-begin prefix
A and B overlap it; no conflict
waits; nothing after C is checked
readReachedEnd = 2: these begins are below a write end already seen and are not compared again
Three begin comparisons. C and every read after it wait for a later write.
B ends before it; C conflicts
readReachedEnd = 3: these begins are below a write end already seen and are not compared again
B leaves from the middle of the list and C from its end; C is also set in the conflict bitmap. A now links straight to readEnd.
readReachedEnd = 3: these begins are below a write end already seen and are not compared again
Only A is visited; the list no longer contains B or C.
A ends before it: list empty
readReachedEnd = 3: these begins are below a write end already seen and are not compared again
The list is empty: the task finishes without reading further writes or leaves.
Why a linked subset, and what the prefix saves
Read ends are not sorted: B ends at 18 and A at 55 although A begins first, so a decided read can be anywhere in the list, and one advancing start index over
a contiguous suffix would not do. Unlinking costs one pointer update and moves no input records; routing boundaries are untouched.
Begins are sorted and live writes are disjoint and ordered, so once a begin is below a write end seen it stays below every later one: the reached prefix
only grows, and those reads skip the begin compare at every later write. Conflict status is tracked separately, in the output bitmap and the task’s links.
